title: Collisions between concave meshes - docs wrong or doesn't work as intended
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4 Beta 1 and 4.3

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 Threads)

### Issue description

Based on the description for [ConcavePolygon3D](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_concavepolygonshape3d.html#concavepolygonshape3d) I would expect to be able to mark a concave rigidbody3d as frozen and get collisions between the frozen rigidbody and another non-frozen concave rigidbody3d. Also, I would expect to be able to get collisions between a concave StaticBody3D and a concave RigidBody3D. 

The wording in the docs doesn't seem to match this - "likely not behave well for CharacterBody3Ds or RigidBody3Ds in a mode other than Static."

Marking the concave rigidbody 3d as frozen - static does not change the collision behavior.

In my testing, collisions between convex and concave rigidbodies works as expected, both frozen and unfrozen.

Is it intended that any collisions between concave meshes work? Or are the docs just unclear? (or is it just my reading comprehension?)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a Rigidbody3D with a CollisionShape3D child using the ConcavePolygon3D shape
2. Duplicate the Rigidbody3D and move it above the original
3. Turn on "Freeze" for lower Rigidbody3D
4. The upper Rigidbody falls through the lower and generates a warning about no collisions between concave meshes.

The same result if the lower body is a StaticBody3D instead of RigidBody3D

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[convex collision.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18496236/convex.collision.zip)
